content.text:
I added every page screenshot to `docs/WRITEUP.md`, in a new "Every page, screenshot by screenshot" section right under the Demo video. I committed and pushed it.

The 14 screenshots are in this order:
- **Landing:** the desktop landing page, the landing page on a phone, and the Studio section of the landing page.
- **The five steps:** add photos, label read, tone and style, backdrop, and building the kit.
- **Results:** the kit ready in 55 seconds, studio photos, image deck, video ad, keywords/tags/SEO title, and the "double-check" list.

I left out the sample-product screenshots (`app-scan-mobile.png`, `app-results-mobile.png` and the other `app-*` phone images) because the Velora screenshots already cover the same screens. Some screenshots now appear twice in the post, once in the earlier sections and once here.
